card.name: Leading zero in ISSN and ID numbers
card.fires_on: The first digits of catalogue numbers, mainly a leading 0 right after ISSN, doi prefixes or sequence IDs in citations. It also fires on the colon or hyphen just before such a number.

modes.label: Leading zero after ISSN
modes.description: The first digit (usually 0) of an ISSN number in a reference list.

modes.label: Digits in DOI or sequence IDs
modes.description: A leading zero or early digit in a doi suffix or an A-number sequence ID.

modes.label: Separator before the number
modes.description: The colon or hyphen just before an ISSN or ISBN number.

card.writes: It seems to push toward number-fragment pieces and away from words like order and class.
card.plain: It lights up on the start of serial or ID numbers in citations, especially a leading zero after ISSN.
